sections.dialog:
Project / RideCircle

RideCircle

In development / exploring

An intercity ride-sharing and carpooling platform for India.

The goal is to connect drivers and passengers for intercity travel, supporting cost-sharing in personal vehicles alongside taxi rides.

Product scope being explored

  • Driver and passenger apps, with an admin dashboard
  • Driver-approved bookings, verification, and ride management
  • Separate carpool and taxi pricing models
  • Cash and online payments
  • GPS tracking and driver/passenger location visibility

Technology directions explored

React Native / FlutterPostgreSQL & PostGISRedisWebSocketsFirebase concepts

An ongoing product exploration using AI-assisted development. The features above describe the intended product scope.
